admission._rule: thin TrafficTwin layer above SUMO routing: a vehicle is admitted to an alternative only if no edge of it would exceed max_edge_load_ratio after admission, and no more than max_share_per_alternative of the vehicles in the round are sent to the same alternative; a vehicle rerouted within reroute_cooldown_s is not advised again
admission._share_gate_min: the share gate only applies to rounds of at least share_gate_min_vehicles vehicles: a single analysed trip is not a herd

protocol.demand: SYNTHETIC_WHAT_IF randomTrips on the real OSM network, one draw per seed, scale 8.0x, profile peak [(0, 600, 0.5), (600, 1500, 0.8), (1500, 2400, 1.0), (2400, 3600, 1.0)]
protocol.od_rule_text: origins and destinations restricted to MAJOR roads (OSM motorway/trunk/primary/secondary incl. links), weight = lanes × length, minimum trip distance 2000 m — demand concentrates on the corridor's arterials instead of the 12k-edge residential grid
protocol.observations: REAL METR-LA detector speeds (mph), replayed as lane speed caps on mapped edges in every arm
protocol.fork: every arm is started from ONE SUMO state saved at fork_t0_s by a baseline prefix run (vehicles, positions, speeds, routes, signals, RNG); lane caps and incidents are re-applied identically after loading

detector.scope: edges with a base-forecast expectation only (DIRECT / DERIVED)

controller.status: FROZEN 2026-09-08 (network-optimizer parameters added on development seeds before any evaluation-seed run of those arms)

seeds.rule: parameters may be chosen only on development seeds; evaluation seeds are never inspected while choosing

candidates._doc: penalty-method diverse alternatives; used only by the network optimizer

assignment._doc: network optimizer: background load from every vehicle on the road, greedy assignment in descending opportunity with load updates, per-route bottleneck admission

optimizer_variants.vehicle: the production route_optimizer (independent vehicles, K duarouter variants, share/capacity gates)
optimizer_variants.div: network optimizer with diverse candidates only (no background load, no route capacity)
optimizer_variants.cap: network optimizer with background load + route capacity but duarouter candidates
optimizer_variants.net: network optimizer: diverse candidates + background load + route capacity + marginal cost

protocol.oracle: oracle_v2x prices every edge with the sampledSeconds-weighted measured travel time of the paired BASELINE run over the routing window (edge_costs.oracle_table) — an experimental upper bound on future information, never leaked into the baseline
protocol.moment_rule: weekday 16:15 of the seed-th held-out weekday: the measured speeds fall over the next 45 min (forecastable build-up, no incident); advances one dataset step per 300 s of simulation

decision_diagnostics.basis: actual per-arm controller trajectories; after a reroute the arm states diverge, so these are operational agreement diagnostics, not a same-state offline candidate replay

oracle_gate.rule: oracle_v2x must beat reactive on total vehicle-hours with a paired 95 % CI that excludes zero (paired() label HELPED)
oracle_gate.scenario_text: forecastable congestion — demand rises to the calibrated level; no incident

PREDICTIVE_TRAFFIC_BENEFIT.rule: HELPED vs baseline and reactive with teleports not HURT
